summary: Preserve intentional suspension across environment and display-name publications and show the hold in apply preview.

replay.detail: Suspension lineage reads existing desired claims; no replay is required.

schema.detail: No claim kinds, receipt fields or database migrations change.

rules.detail: Claim admission and actor authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Suspension follows the declared-launch comparator used by preview and reconcile. Environment, label and other non-launch edits preserve the hold. Process launch tokens, restart budgets and crash-loop parking keep their existing boundaries: an environment edit still resets the process retry budget. An old-build member still releases the hold on environment edits; upgrade all runtime owners and publishers before relying on this behavior. Immediate launch-changing publication still releases suspension under the existing policy, now visibly in preview.

manual.detail: Preview names the suspension and says hold kept or would start a suspended agent. Environment edits are retained for explicit resume. Manual pending launch changes keep the existing hold and still require explicit rollout after resume.

recovery.detail: A non-launch publication keeps the saved native-session binding. Explicit resume receives the updated environment and verifies the original session.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling daemon upgrade; restart interruption has not been measured.
